name: W. C. Cranston
bio: W. C. Cranston, called "the Blonde butcher," worked in Medora in summer 1885 and fought glove contests with a man named Ware in Chicago, losing by knockout in the second round in March 1886. In July 1886 he returned to Medora with Frank Foster's force of butchers.
